motions.headline: School district agreement restated a third time
motions.summary: The council ran the same three-city school district agreement through a third resolution, again acknowledging the central district being formed by Alpine, Highland, Cedar Hills, Lehi and American Fork.
motions.impact: Duplicate paperwork on a decision that matters: the schools your children attend are what is at stake, but this particular item adds nothing to it.

motions.headline: Same school district deal, second resolution
motions.summary: The council handled the same April 29 agreement with Saratoga Springs and Fairfield Town under a second resolution number, with the same nod to the five-city district to the north.
motions.impact: The substance is the school district agreement recorded again under another number. Nothing here reaches you beyond what that agreement already does.

motions.motion: Councilmember Thomas moved to adopt Resolution R2O24-12 approving an interlocal Agreement between Eagle Mountain City, the City of Saratoga Springs, and Fairfield Town for the Creation of a School Distnct dated April29, 2024, and to support and acknowledge the interlocal Agreement between Alpine, Highland, Cedar Hills, Lehi, and American Fork creating a central school district Councilmember Panek seconded the motion.
motions.headline: New school district with Saratoga Springs and Fairfield
motions.summary: The council took up an agreement with Saratoga Springs and Fairfield Town to create their own school district, and backed five neighboring cities forming a central district.
motions.impact: If you have school-age children, this points toward a district shared with Saratoga Springs and Fairfield rather than the one your schools sit in now. What changes in classrooms and on tax bills was not settled here.
